notes.title: Rendezvous Original Soundtrack now Available - FOR FREE
notes.notes:
We're super happy to announce that the game's original soundtrack is now available to download along with the purchase of the game, absolutely for free here on Steam. This 28-track album composed by Arkaeus features ambient synthwave vibes to deepen the experience of the players while they explore Bay City, Neo-Surabaya, and other areas in the game. It features 2 CDs, split between songs that made it into the game and songs that were cut. Featuring songs such as "Nine Dragons", "Approaching the Unknown", "History of Arum" and the hit single "Shadows of the Past". 


Another big bonus is that this original soundtrack is fully copyright and content-ID free, meaning you can stream this on your favorite platforms without worrying about copyright strikes. It's also available Hi-Res here on Steam and is released on every platform, including Spotify, TikTok, and Bandcamp.

Arkaeus -- who also goes by the name of tautheory -- is a long-time music composer based in Indonesia and has released 2 albums, 1 EP, and multiple Singles and Remixes in his career. His signature style can be heard in almost every track that he's released, where he describes every "song tells a unique tale within a construct of a story".

[previewyoutube=1SRIlzla2oM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Bandcamp[/b] Link: https://arkaeus.bandcamp.com/album/rendezvous-original-soundtrack-2023

[b]Spotify[/b]: https://open.spotify.com/album/2mbSsVOwGLGqQS6L25Um8w

notes.title: Neo-Surabaya Demo Announcement and Updates
notes.notes:
Hiya! Happy New Year!

It's been quite a long time since we posted our last devlog right? Many things have changed and we have exciting news for you!

[h1]Rendezvous: Shadows of the Past demo now cover Neo-Surabaya for a limited time![/h1]

Yes, we hear you all! You want to see the Neo-Surabaya right?

You can now experience the Wonokromo part of Neo-Surabaya in the limited-time prologue demo of our Cyber-Noir adventure. Available free from [h3]January - February 2023[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/d9a6a996052759564aaf4cae6a3603c38819b147.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825480/Rendezvous_Shadows_of_the_Past/

[h2]The Wonokromo[/h2]
In the limited demo, we bring you the Wonokromo. A place where you can find the remnants of the old world and tradition crashed with technological advancement that has overtaken the city. Here you can find preman thugs, a workshop with cannibalized stuff, cyberunner gangs doing their things, and many more!

Some said you can find the infamous thieves' market somewhere near the station in Wonokromo, both in Neo-Surabaya and the real-life Surabaya. You can find thieves, ordinary citizens, to police officers in this place, not doing any arrests. Interesting situation huh? Anything you want or need to find, just ask the fencer, he’ll probably gonna get you some in no time. With the right price of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/ec3e4a326be80f72b63d4ee7083e295de5b64d05.png[/img]
[i]A great place to find nighttime street foods. You might wanna try some martabak, lalapan, and mie ayam.[/i]

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]
From the street of Bay City to the Sea Wall of Neo-Surabaya, we have already detailed the environments of cyberpunk cities. We’ve completed the settings, balanced the game, and fixed some bugs, audio, and translations.

We heard your feedback and we try to bring the best Rendezvous experience to you. While the combat itself isn’t a big focus in the game, we’ve balanced the stealth and combat gameplay.

Fixed some bugs, glitches, and English localization. Many thanks to Tautheory for his part in localizing and proofreading the game into English! We also fixed some audio where you can’t hear some of the character's voices during cutscenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/1cf46a9f7908aaf28f29ee0b502c79c73d257c84.png[/img]
[i]“What?! I can’t hear you!”[/i]


I think that’s all I can tell you right now. I have a story to share about the Neo-Surabaya and its development, but that’s for the next devlog okay? Great!

Hope you guys have some “fun” in Wonokromo! Peace!

Oh and don’t forget to join our Discord server!
[h3][url=https://discord.gg/3m55qdS]Pendopo Creations[/url][/h3]

-MT, one of the dev.

notes.title: August 2021 Updates and Announcement
notes.notes:
Hiya, guys!

We hope you're staying safe, healthy, and happy!

We're still working on Rendezvous, and the development is going well. It's been quite a long time since we posted our last devlog, and since then many things have changed for the better! !— here's what's been going on since our last update:

[h2] Characters Portrait[/h2]
After some consideration, we decided to add character portraits to the majority of the conversation interactions. We think it's important to convey emotional nuance in a game like this, and portraits are really valuable for immersion in a character-heavy narrative. Besides the main characters, we're also planning to give some minor characters their own portraits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/3b92edfea2c21c8da2b0c1c06293d94f8c0c45f0.png[/img]

[h2]Entering the Neo-Surabaya[/h2]
After some tweaking here and there in the Bay City, we have finally entered the development in the Neo-Surabaya parts. We've completed some NPC, environment, and background art for the first part of the city. We’re bringing some landmarks from the real-life city of Surabaya while adding cyberpunk/futurist elements to better fit the story and the lore— we hope you appreciate this attention to detail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/ce721048ee2d733bbf6319608de185ac8869566a.png[/img]

[h2]Overall Progress[/h2]
We've almost completed polishing the prologue of the game, from polishing the city to overhauling the enemy AI. We’ve also completed the game's navigation from mouse+keyboard to full keyboard, and for the most part, the joystick support is almost done. With respect to the narrative, we’re near completion on the fully-finished story and dialogue. We can't wait to share the full experience with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/82d74cc977fc7c9cc5bffdae083f94dc473399ca.png[/img]

[h2]We're at Exhibitions[/h2]
Aside from our development progress, we also want to share some happy news with you. We’ve got curated and will appear on Indonesia Bekraf Game Prime and Gamescom 2021 online exhibition! The Bekraf Game Prime will be held from 6-8 August 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38701172/a74d4c6beaa9462fd1c5d4bf62a672e707328a3a.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks! Don’t forget to play the demo and wishlist rendezvous. Stay safe, healthy, and happy!
